content.title: New York City Half Marathon 2026 – Race Info, Course & Results
content.text: The United Airlines NYC Half is a premier half marathon event that takes runners on a 13.1-mile journey through the streets of Manhattan, starting in Brooklyn and finishing in Central Park. Organized by New York Road Runners, it attracts elite and recreational runners from around the world, showcasing iconic city landmarks along the way. Race Details Status Finished Location New York City, NY, United States Date 15 March 2026 Distance Half Marathon VDOT Participants 616 Avg. VDOT finish times 1:53:49 The United Airlines NYC Half is a premier half marathon event that takes runners on a 13.1-mile journey through the streets of Manhattan, starting in Brooklyn and finishing in Central Park. Organized by New York Road Runners, it attracts elite and recreational runners from around the world, showcasing iconic city landmarks along the way. Course Terrain The course features city streets, bridges (including the Manhattan Bridge), and Central Park. It is primarily urban and paved, with some rolling segments through the park and moderate inclines on bridges. Elevation Changes The race includes a notable incline over the Manhattan Bridge early in the course, gentle rollers through Manhattan streets, and some undulating terrain in Central Park toward the finish.
